lab.bullet1: Same deployment: append /lab.html to your site URL and bookmark it.
lab.bullet2: Keep experimental commits on lab. Merging all of lab into main is not the default; pick and approve the changes to promote.
lab.bullet3: When a feature is stable, move it into production pages (e.g. ggongbab.html, food.html) while keeping the public data contract and checks.
lab.bullet4: Code existing on lab, being merged to main, and working in production are three different facts.
lab.bullet5: lab-ggongbab.html uses the same renderer as ggongbab.html to check fixture and localhost preview modes. Visitors use ggongbab.html.

privacy.intro: Babdoduk (the “Service”) is a website that tells the KAIST community about free-food events and food content. Its operator, Minseok Lee (the “Operator”), follows the Personal Information Protection Act of Korea and related laws. This policy explains what personal information the Service handles, why, for how long, and who helps process it.
privacy.s1.abuseItems: When you send a tip or a menu-picker reaction: your IP address mixed with the date and a secret value, so that the original address cannot be recovered
privacy.s1.googleItems: Email address, name, profile picture URL, Google account identifier
privacy.s1.kakaoItems: Nickname, profile picture URL, Kakao account identifier, email address (only if you agree to share it)
privacy.s1.lead: If you only browse the site without signing in, the Operator receives no name or contact details. Personal information is handled only in the cases below.
privacy.s1.logsItems: IP address, access time and browser information (security logs kept by our hosting and sign-in providers)
privacy.s1.note: Passwords are managed by Google and Kakao; the Service never receives or stores them. An email address received through sign-in is not shown on screen or used to contact you.
privacy.s1.savedItems: A display name you choose, saved free-food events, your restaurant list (places, want-to-go / been / go-again status, your own notes) and place lists
privacy.s1.tipItems: Your tip text (up to 1,000 characters), photos (up to 3) and the time it was sent
privacy.s1.title: 1. Information we handle
privacy.s10.body: All connections are encrypted (HTTPS). Database permissions let each user read and write only their own data, and administrative secrets stay on the Operator’s own computer. Tip photos are stored privately with no public address.
privacy.s10.title: 10. How we protect it
privacy.s11.name: Officer: Minseok Lee (Operator)
privacy.s11.title: 11. Privacy officer
privacy.s12.i1: Personal Information Infringement Report Center: privacy.kisa.or.kr, call 118
privacy.s12.i2: Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: www.kopico.go.kr, 1833-6972
privacy.s12.i3: Supreme Prosecutors’ Office: www.spo.go.kr, call 1301
privacy.s12.i4: Korean National Police Agency: ecrm.police.go.kr, call 182
privacy.s12.lead: If you need advice or redress about a privacy issue, you can contact these Korean agencies.
privacy.s12.title: 12. Where to get help
privacy.s13.body: If this policy changes, we will announce it on this page and in the Service; the new policy applies from the day it is posted.
privacy.s13.title: 13. Changes to this policy
privacy.s2.i1: Signing you in and telling accounts apart
privacy.s2.i2: Showing your saved events and restaurant list on any of your devices
privacy.s2.i3: Reviewing free-food tips and turning them into event listings on the tip board
privacy.s2.i4: Preventing abuse such as floods of submissions, and checking security and errors
privacy.s2.title: 2. Why we use it
privacy.s3.i1: Account and saved items: kept until you leave. When you leave, the account and everything saved with it are deleted immediately. You can also delete only the saved items and keep the account.
privacy.s3.i2: Tip photos: deleted 14 days after the Operator approves or rejects the tip.
privacy.s3.i3: Tip text and the review result: kept as part of the free-food record while the Service runs, and deleted on request.
privacy.s3.i4: Abuse-prevention values: counting records are deleted after one day; the value attached to a tip is kept with that tip.
privacy.s3.i5: Automatic records: kept for each provider’s own retention period (see section 5).
privacy.s3.note: The Service takes no payments or orders, so there is no personal information it must keep separately by law.
privacy.s3.title: 3. How long we keep it
privacy.s4.body: The Operator does not sell or give your personal information to anyone, except where the law requires it or an investigative authority asks through due process. Only an event’s name, place, date, time and food reach the public tip board; the original tip text and photos are never published.
privacy.s4.title: 4. Sharing with third parties
privacy.s5.lead: The Service relies on the providers below, so your information may be stored or processed on servers outside Korea. It is sent over encrypted connections when you use the related feature.
privacy.s5.loginItems: Google or Kakao sign-in information from section 1
privacy.s5.loginWhat: Confirming sign-in with the account you choose
privacy.s5.openaiWhat: Reading tip text and photos to draft the event name, place, time and so on
privacy.s5.refuse: If you do not sign in or send a tip, none of your personal information goes to these providers; you just cannot use sign-in or tips.
privacy.s5.supabase: Supabase Inc. (US company; servers in Seoul, Korea)
privacy.s5.supabaseItems: Sign-in information, saved items, tips, abuse-prevention values and security logs from section 1
privacy.s5.supabaseWhat: Sign-in, database, storage of tip photos
privacy.s5.telegramItems: Tip text, one tip photo and the drafted event details
privacy.s5.telegramWhat: Sending each tip to the Operator for review
privacy.s5.title: 5. Processors and transfers abroad
privacy.s5.vercelItems: IP address, access time, browser information
privacy.s6.i1: Your language, events saved without signing in, chosen filters, your restaurant list and similar settings stay in your browser’s own storage. They are not sent to the Operator, and you can clear them in your browser settings at any time.
privacy.s6.i2: When you sign in, a value that keeps you signed in is stored in your browser and removed when you sign out.
privacy.s6.i3: We use no advertising or tracking cookies and no analytics tools. Loading web fonts (Google Fonts) or using the KakaoTalk share button may let those companies receive connection information.
privacy.s6.title: 6. What is stored in your browser
privacy.s7.i1: Signed-in users can delete their saved items or leave the Service themselves on the My Babdoduk page.
privacy.s7.i2: You may ask at any time to see, correct or delete your information, or to stop its processing, including deleting a tip you sent. Write to joshualiuniv@gmail.com; we will reply with the outcome within 10 days.
privacy.s7.title: 7. Your rights
privacy.s8.body: The Service is not meant for children under 14. If you are under 14, please do not sign in or send tips. If we learn that we hold information from a child under 14, we delete it promptly.
privacy.s8.title: 8. Children under 14
privacy.s9.body: Information is deleted as soon as its retention period ends or its purpose is fulfilled. Electronic files are deleted so they cannot be restored; no personal information is kept on paper.
privacy.s9.title: 9. How we delete information
